reason: The immutable cumulative-state reference ends before the 2023-12-31 strategy cutoff and cannot itself generate 2024H1 signals. A single measurement definition must span pre-2024 preparation and the first official interval. The primary information source is therefore frozen to finalized canonical Uniswap V3 Swap logs from the same USDC/WETH 0.05% pool through the public SQD Ethereum Portal. The immutable Hugging Face snapshot remains an identity and aggregate-coverage cross-check only.

primary_source.availability: finalized block timestamp plus conservative two completed UTC hours

source_sequence.source_gate: download and aggregate the complete signed Swap stream from 2021-07-01 through 2023-12-31; probe only two frozen small 2024H1 windows for schema and transport continuity
source_sequence.pre2024_model: train, calibrate, confirm and develop only on information dated no later than 2023-12-31
source_sequence.official_2024H1: download the complete 2024H1 Swap stream only after the pre-2024 model, policy, risk and notional rule are frozen and the prewritten gate passes

direction_semantics.amount0_positive_amount1_negative: USDC enters the pool and WETH leaves; completed WETH purchase pressure; positive signed inventory transfer
direction_semantics.amount0_negative_amount1_positive: USDC leaves the pool and WETH enters; completed WETH sale pressure; negative signed inventory transfer

unchanged: one pooled HGBT and one isotonic calibration map
one continuation, exhaustion-reversal or flat structural action rule
ETHUSDT only and one global slot
structural target, stop and invalidation exits with no elapsed-time liquidation
conditional pre-2024 risk and notional search
immediate official 2024H1 evaluation after freezing at 2023-12-31
